Mainland China’s foreign reserves would continue to increase asset allocation in Hong Kong, providing further momentum to the city’s capital market development, the governor of the People’s Bank of China (PBOC) said on Tuesday.
Speaking at the Hong Kong FIC & Bond Connect Summit, Pan Gongsheng unveiled several substantial policy enhancements, including a 60 per cent hike in the investment quota for Bond Connect’s southbound segment, alongside measures to expand investment channels and diversify...
